checks.rollout-normalized-shape: Run-private percentage and tenants prove exact keys, boolean coercion, trim, deduplication, and first-seen order.
checks.rollout-input-immutable: A deep pre-call snapshot is compared with the caller object after normalization.
checks.rollout-new-object: Identity comparison proves normalization does not return the caller object.
checks.rollout-invalid-object: Null, array, and primitive object partitions must each throw TypeError.
checks.rollout-invalid-percentage: Missing, negative, fractional, above-100, and unsafe-integer partitions must throw TypeError.
checks.rollout-invalid-tenants: Missing, non-array, non-string-member, and whitespace-only member partitions must throw TypeError.
checks.rollout-tenant-override: A run-private listed tenant with an otherwise losing bucket must be enabled.
checks.rollout-percentage-boundaries: Buckets zero, percentage-minus-one, percentage, and 99 exercise the exclusive threshold.
checks.rollout-disabled-missing-subject: Disabled rollout plus null and undefined subjects must all resolve false.
checks.rollout-invalid-bucket: Negative, fractional, 100, and non-finite buckets must each throw TypeError.
checks.feature-access-reasons: Disabled, nullish, override, percentage, not-eligible, and invalid-bucket partitions exercise every exact reason and propagation rule.
checks.rollout-summary: Unnormalized run-private input must be normalized into the exact summary string.
checks.rollout-summary-validates: An invalid percentage proves summary delegates to rollout validation.
checks.query-normalization: Precomposed and extended combining marks plus tabs, case, and repeated whitespace exercise the normalization pipeline.
checks.query-nullish: Null and undefined become empty while a number proves non-nullish stringification.
checks.catalog-name-tag-order: Name, string-tag, order, empty-query, and non-string-tag partitions are asserted independently.
checks.catalog-input-immutable: A deep pre-call snapshot is compared after catalog search.
checks.catalog-limit-contract: Omitted and empty options prove default 20; one and MAX_SAFE_INTEGER prove valid boundaries.
checks.catalog-invalid-input: Non-array items, null/array/primitive options, and six invalid limit classes must throw TypeError.
checks.catalog-shared-normalizer: The catalog source must import normalizeQuery from the shared contract module.
checks.search-render-exact-escaping: Exact markup asserts ids and names escape all five required characters.
checks.search-render-order: Two run-private ids prove ordered one-li-per-result output.
checks.search-render-empty: The empty array must produce the exact accessible empty list.
checks.search-render-invalid-input: Null and plain-object result partitions must throw TypeError.
checks.lease-acquire-input-validation: Empty/whitespace key-owner, four invalid-now classes, five invalid-ttl classes, and zero/MIN_VALUE valid boundaries are exercised.
checks.lease-renew-input-validation: Renew repeats every key-owner and numeric invalid partition plus zero/MIN_VALUE valid boundaries.
checks.lease-release-current-input-validation: Release and current each reject empty and whitespace-only identifiers.
checks.lease-contention-inclusive-expiry: A live competing owner loses at expiry-minus-one and wins exactly at expiry.
checks.lease-same-owner-reacquire: A live same owner reacquires and resets the exact expiry.
checks.lease-renew-contract: Wrong owner, live owner, exact new expiry, and inclusive expired boundary prove boolean renewal semantics.
checks.lease-release-contract: Wrong owner, current owner, and already-absent release calls prove exact booleans.
checks.lease-snapshot-isolation: Undefined absence and mutation of a returned snapshot prove no internal reference escapes.
checks.with-lease-success-callback: A bare callable renew argument, boolean renewal, result propagation, and cleanup are asserted.
checks.with-lease-busy: A live competing owner must cause a rejection containing busy.
checks.with-lease-failure-cleanup: An operation exception is preserved and the owned lease is removed in finally.
checks.with-lease-owner-change-cleanup: Replacement at exact expiry survives the prior owner's finally cleanup.
checks.migration-step-validation: Non-array, empty/whitespace/duplicate ids, and non-callable step apply partitions must throw TypeError.
checks.migration-dependency-validation: Non-array, unknown, and non-string dependency partitions must throw TypeError.
checks.migration-cycle-validation: Self-cycle and two-node cycle partitions must throw TypeError.
checks.migration-stable-chain-order: A reverse-declared run-private dependency chain must become prepare-transform-finalize.
checks.migration-stable-ready-order: Independent ready siblings and a newly ready earlier-index node prove stable Kahn selection.
checks.migration-input-immutable: Array identity/order and every dependency array are compared after planning.
checks.migration-runner-input-validation: Malformed runner fields, malformed steps, and two dependency-unsafe orderings must reject.
checks.migration-checkpoint-validation: Non-array state and an unknown run-private id must reject.
checks.migration-skip-write-return: Persisted prefix skipping, apply order, per-step fresh writes, exact return, and identity isolation are asserted.
checks.migration-crash-resume: A one-time middle-step crash proves checkpoint boundary and exact retry call sequence.
checks.migration-return-isolation: Mutating the returned completed array must not mutate the last persisted array.
checks.runtime-route-validation: Unknown envelope fields, unsupported kinds, non-record payloads, non-empty read payloads, and malformed scout objectives exercise every closed routing boundary.
checks.runtime-route-exact-contract: All four commands assert exact terminal text, confirmation authority, model-call budget, effect classification, and no extra output keys.
checks.runtime-confirmation-authority: An unconfirmed read succeeds while every model, semantic, and state-changing route is rejected until confirmed exactly true.
checks.runtime-revision-validation: Negative, fractional, stale, missing, and overflow revisions prove exact optimistic-concurrency boundaries before durable state changes.
checks.runtime-idempotent-replay: A stale but identical replay must preserve state identity and stored replay state while returning only a replay-marked receipt clone.
checks.runtime-idempotency-conflict: Reusing a private key for a different command and using prototype-poison keys must throw before changing state.
checks.runtime-digest-canonical: An independent SHA-256 oracle, reversed nested key order, and rejected non-JSON values exercise the exported canonical digest contract.
checks.runtime-receipt-shape: Exact receipt keys, command metadata, revision transition, and a single increment prove the durable audit-record contract.
checks.runtime-state-isolation: Deep caller snapshots plus returned/stored receipt mutation probes prove no input or internal receipt reference escapes.
checks.runtime-control-summary: Exact punctuation, JSON command quoting, model budget, replay flag, and invalid input partitions exercise the operator-facing summary.
checks.timeline-snapshot-validation: Negative cursors, duplicate message ids, malformed messages, bad seen digests, and fresh nested outputs exercise snapshot normalization.
checks.timeline-event-validation: Malformed event arrays, options, identifiers, cursor, offset, text, completion, and budget values exercise every event boundary.
checks.timeline-replay-and-conflicts: Identical duplicates, conflicting duplicate ids, duplicate cursors, and first-observed replay order exercise event identity semantics.
checks.timeline-historical-validation: A matching private historical digest replays once while unknown or changed history is rejected before projection.
checks.timeline-contiguous-gap: Out-of-order contiguous events apply in cursor order, while a first gap stops and buffers that event plus all later work.
checks.timeline-offset-completion: New-message creation, exact append offsets, message order, and rejection after completion exercise causal text assembly.
checks.timeline-budget-boundary: A private exact-capacity append succeeds and the following event atomically backpressures with all exact diagnostic fields.
checks.timeline-input-isolation: Deep snapshots and nested mutation probes across messages, seen, and buffered events prove projection never aliases caller data.
checks.timeline-checkpoint-roundtrip: A normalized private snapshot must survive encode/decode exactly and each decode must return independently mutable data.
checks.timeline-checkpoint-tamper: Malformed JSON, schema changes, payload edits, checksum edits, and invalid structures must all fail integrity validation.
checks.timeline-render-exact: Two ordered private rows assert exact accessible markup, completion states, and escaping of all five HTML-sensitive characters.
checks.timeline-render-validation: Null and object inputs throw TypeError while an empty array returns the exact accessible ordered-list shell.
